arguments.message: When you switch to a new phone, the authenticator app you reinstall generates its own secret, so the codes no longer match the ones Meridian has on file. To fix this, go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**, tap **Reset**, and set up 2FA again just like the first time – scan the new QR code and confirm with the fresh six‑digit code. If you still have a recovery code from the original enrollment, you can use that to sign in and reset the 2FA settings. Remember, we’ll never ask you to share your 2FA code over the phone or chat.
